_classes.name: Local boards of elections stored as the State Board of Elections
_classes.rule: agency == 'Board of Elections' (agency_full 'State Board of Elections', jurisdiction state) and 'state' not in actor_raw.lower() and 'state' not in actor_resolved_model.lower()  (model itself said 'boards of elections' / 'county boards of elections'; should be agency 'Boards of elections', jurisdiction local)

_classes.name: Pre-2017 record built on reprinted text whose only braced token is a single capitalized word or acronym (ufsd, shall, tlc, mayor)
_classes.rule: session < 2017; locate quote in packet LAW TEXT with [deleted] removed; braced chars inside the quote span form exactly one alphabetic word of 2-6 letters that is not a number/ordinal/roman numeral word. Candidate filter only: some hits are genuine one-word amendments, so each needs a read

_classes.name: actor_raw annotated or invented instead of the law's own words (passive subject plus parenthetical actor)
_classes.rule: '(' in actor_raw and actor_raw.lower() not a substring of the packet LAW TEXT (braces/brackets stripped, lowercased)

2013-S3070-02.note: Operative 'the assessor, upon approval by the Town of Pelham, Village of Pelham Manor and Pelham {{ufsd}} Board, may make appropriate correction to the subject roll' is reprinted text; the only brace is 'ufsd', an uppercase acronym braced by the pre-2017 rule, and at most renames a body in the approval condition. action_summary's '(ufsd board added)' rests on that artefact.

effective_date.note: 'on the one hundred eightieth day after it shall have become a law', signed 2011-09-23 + 180 days

2015-S1848-01.note: 'The board of Elections may authorize election officials to affix a paster or sticker upon unvoted ballots' (Election Law 7-126) is the county/NYC board that runs the poll site; the model resolved 'boards of elections' but the store mapped it to State Board of Elections. (Definition of 'board of elections' as the county/city board is Election Law 1-104, outside the packet text.)

2015-S1848-02.note: 'All of the voted ballots for which the use of a paster or sticker shall have been authorized shall be manually canvassed' is canvassed by the local board; stored as State Board, and actor_raw 'voted ballots (board of elections)' is not the law's wording.

missed.quote: At any time after two months have elapsed since the final date for filing applications for a competitive examination for original appointment, the eligible list resulting from such examination may be established
missed.agency: DCS and municipal civil service commissions (Local agencies and authorities)
missed.note: Authority to establish the eligible list notwithstanding a pending credit claim; borderline (could be read as a condition of the two-month duty). Not in dropped/2009.json.
